description:
It's my first time leading a team, and I'm determined to make it a successful experience.

I'm looking for participants with knowledge or skills in:

EE (Electrical Engineering)

AE (Aerospace Engineering)

CS (Computer Science)

SE (Software Engineering)

Or any other field you believe could contribute to our project! 

  I truly believe this team can do great things, regardless of the final rank we achieve. What matters most is learning, working together, and giving it our best.
